title: Bug: `on` mixin handler runs twice in "nested" `clientEntry` components
author: okalil
body_preview: ### Reproduction steps 1. Run https://github.com/okalil/remix-3-beta-bugs/tree/main/on-mixin-runs-twice 2. Click the first button, see 'click' logged once. 3. Click the second button, see 'click' logged twice.  ### Expected behavior On click the second button `'click'` is also logged once.  ### Actual behavior On click the second button `'click'` is logged twice.
